name: How long does a typical strength training session last at your gym?
description: Strength training sessions at Cave Training typically last 45-60 minutes, including warm-up, main workout, and cool-down, for efficient and effective training.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical strength training session last at your gym?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical strength training session at Cave Training usually lasts between 45 to 60 minutes. This includes a warm-up, the main workout incorporating various functional strength exercises, and a cool-down period. The exact duration can depend on the specific program, whether it's a group class or personal training, and individual needs. Our structured sessions ensure efficient and effective training, maximizing your time to achieve fitness goals within the allocated period.
